description.zh: 自动快照策略要创建的快照的磁盘类型。
description.en: The type of cloud disk for which the automatic snapshot policy creates snapshots.
The ID of the automatic snapshot policy.

description.zh: 自动快照策略的名称。长度为2\~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（\_）或者短划线（-）。默认值：空。
description.en: The name of the automatic snapshot policy. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. The name must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), or hyphens (-). Default value: empty.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service.

description.zh: 自动快照的保留时间，单位为天。取值范围：1\~180。
description.en: The retention period of automatic snapshots. Unit: days. Valid values: 1 to 180.
